mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%) and high unemployment (UNRATE ≥ 6.5%) indicates recessionary monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 thousand units in a housing market expansion regime signals robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of housing expansion periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand/month) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100 (index base 2017=100) over 3 months signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% sustained for 3 months), the Federal Reserve's inflation-fighting policy causes temporary equity valuation compression, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of tightening periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1000 thousand) and industrial production (INDPRO > 102) signals synchronized demand-supply expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of interaction instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
